name: Guns & Bottles
author: Addicting Games
description: "Guns and Bottles" is an exciting bottle-shooting game that challenges your accuracy and timing skills. Aim carefully to shoot the spinning bottles while your gun rotates, adding a unique twist to the challenge. Tap the screen to hit the bottles and score points. Hit three bottles in a row to earn bonus coins, but be cautious—hitting a red bottle will end the game! Gather coins to unlock powerful new guns and take your shooting skills to the next level. Get ready for a thrilling test of reflexes and precision with "Guns and Bottles"!
